task: Fix layout so pagination and Show controls on the cost center details projects list no longer overlap project rows (EPMCDME-16326).

key_reasoning.reason: Expected behaviour is clear, but the overlap mechanism was not identified statically in CostCenterProjectsManager (Pagination is in normal flow after an embedded Table); browser reproduction is needed, and the ignored per-page argument in handlePaginationChange is an adjacent open scope question.
Presentation-only fix in CostCenterProjectsManager / CostCenterDetailsPage; shared Table/Pagination should be avoided and the fix kept local.
